name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: Senior Product Designer
tagline: Product direction, interface craft, and an AI-assisted build practice.
intro: What holds my attention is interaction design — how a thing responds, what it does while it waits, and how it recovers. I build to find out: a prototype in code answers questions a static frame cannot.
contactLede: Senior product designer at InstaDeep. Open to conversations about product work and collaborations.
about: AI, blockchain and fintech: three domains where someone has to act on a system they cannot check for themselves. That is the work — making an interface carry trust it cannot ask for.

Today I'm a senior product designer at InstaDeep, an AI company acquired by BioNTech, working on their AI products and the design system underneath them. Before that I led product design at Steer, and at T-ledger I designed one of Tunisia's first digital wallets, built on blockchain.
I also build what I design. This site is the proof: my Figma, my code, my tests.
Based in Tunis — UTC+1, the same working day as Paris and Berlin.

experience.note: AI products, and the design system every InstaDeep product surface and demo runs on.
The only person in design and product, leading the front-end and back-end engineers. The company went on to raise in France.
Sole designer across both of the company's products.
